spec.name: Sentiment Revisions Strategy
spec.notes: Strategy based on sentiment revisions, top 20% long, bottom 20% short.

claim.text: A high Sharpe ratio strategy based on sentiment revisions, with top 20% long and bottom 20% short positions. The strategy has a Sharpe ratio of 12.61, with low volatility and drawdowns.

exhibits.summary: Delaying the signal by 1 more bar moves the Sharpe ratio from 12.61 to 0.74 (change -11.87).
At 0 bps the Sharpe ratio is 12.61 (as submitted, 0 bps: 12.61); it breaks even at 80.2 bps with daily turnover 0.20.
The real signal's gross Sharpe of 12.61 beats 100% of 200 shuffled signals (shuffled mean 0.02, 95th percentile 0.59).
The best year gives 13% of total P&L (year 1) and calm regimes give 72%; Sharpe is 13.1 in calm and 15.47 in stressed regimes.
The log shows a single trial, so there is no selection to correct for.

verdict.opinion: The strategy exhibits lookahead bias, as delaying the signal by 1 bar significantly reduces the Sharpe ratio, indicating the strategy relies on future data.
